Add_AlertsConflict: {0} has an alert for the same condition at both {1} and {2} ({3}). Delete one of the two first, then change the data source.
Add_CannotSearch: {0} cannot search. Press Add to use "{1}" as typed.
Add_NoSourceEnabled: No data source is enabled for this asset class. Enable one in Settings.
Add_TypeSymbol: Type the {0} symbol, then press Add.
Add_TypeToSearch: Type a name or symbol to search.
Alert_DuplicateCondition: This instrument already has an alert with this condition.
Alert_ThresholdUnchanged: Change the price to the one you want to be alerted at.
Alert_MovedBody: The {0} alert(s) on {1} keep their price levels. Check them if the new source quotes in another currency.
Holding_CurrencyTip: The currency of the cost price and of the quoted price. For the total, amounts are converted to the base currency.
Holding_InvalidCost: Enter a cost price above zero.
Settings_ReadFailedBody: settings.json is locked or unreadable, so the defaults are in use. Changes are not saved while that lasts; once the file is free, your next change loads the saved settings again.
Alert_RepeatTip: Alert again each time the condition comes true. Otherwise the alert turns itself off after it fires.
BossKey_FailedBody: {0} is used by another program, so the boss key does not work. Choose another key in the settings.
Row_AlertAbove: Alert when the price rises to {0}
Row_AlertBelow: Alert when the price falls to {0}
Row_SparklineTip: Price trend over the last 60 minutes
Settings_AlertsHelp: All price alerts. Add one from the right-click menu of an instrument.
Settings_AutoHideHint: Needs Always on top. Drag the window to the left, right or top edge; point at the edge to bring it back
Settings_AutoHideUnavailable: Not available here: this system does not let a window be placed beyond the screen edge
Settings_CardGroupingHint: Only applies to the card layout
Settings_CardSizeHint: Small shows the name and price only; large adds the range and the change in amount
Settings_CloseToTrayHint: When off, closing the window exits FluxTick
Settings_CompactHint: Hides the charts in the list
Settings_DataAndLogsHint: Settings and logs are kept on this computer.
Settings_DeleteGroupTip: Delete group (its instruments move to the first remaining group)
Settings_Disclaimer: Market data may be delayed or inaccurate and is not investment advice.
Settings_GroupsHelp: Groups organize the cards in the card layout when grouping is set to Custom groups.
Settings_MarketStatus: Show the state of the market
Settings_MarketStatusHint: Marks pre-market, after hours, break and closed, and says closed instead of stale when a market is shut; the prices of a closed market then count in the totals. With it off, they are stale and stay out of the totals.
Settings_LaunchAtLoginHint: Start FluxTick automatically when you sign in to Windows
Settings_LayoutHint: Cards wrap to fill the window width
Settings_OpenFolderFailed: The folder could not be opened.
Settings_RestoreDefaultsTip: Put this source's options back to their built-in values (secret values such as keys are kept)
Settings_StartMinimizedHint: Keep the window hidden at startup; click the tray icon to show it
Settings_TrayAssetsHelp: The instruments the tray list shows. Drag them into the order you want; it holds at most {0}.
Settings_TrayAssetsEmpty: Nothing here yet. Right-click an instrument in the main window and choose “Add to tray list”.
Watch_TrayFull: The tray list is full (at most {0})
Settings_ThemeHint: Auto: follow the system light / dark setting
Settings_BaseCurrencyHint: The total profit and loss of all holdings is shown in this currency. Exchange rates update hourly.
Settings_BossKeyHint: Click the box and press the keys. Backspace turns it off.
Update_AutoCheckHint: Looks for a new release on GitHub when FluxTick starts and then about once a day. On Windows it offers to install it
Update_Downloaded: Downloaded and verified. Unpack it and replace FluxTick to finish the update.
Update_DownloadedInstall: Downloaded and verified. FluxTick closes, updates and starts again.
Update_Failed: Could not check or download. Try again later.
Update_Installing: Installing… FluxTick closes and starts again when the update is done.
Update_NoPackage: This release has no package for your platform.
Validation_Choice: Must be one of the listed choices.
Watch_EmptyHint: Press + to add a stock, coin, currency or index.
